info.title: Event Ticketing API
info.description: T1.4 contract; only actuator health implemented at T1.3. Roles/profiles/body limits are server requirements, not enforced by this file.

post.description: Contract v0; implementation follows TASKS.  Same account/operation/key and canonical payload replays original 202/body even after expiry; key with changed payload returns 409. Commit hold before responding.

503.description: BOOKING_BUSY Retry only after rollback; lock_timeout=1500ms, statement_timeout=5s. Exact transaction budgets and 55P03/57014 mapping: ADR 0002.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before retry with the SAME Idempotency-Key

post.description: Contract v0; implementation follows TASKS. Only CUSTOMER owner; other owners get 404. requestId dedup scoped by booking; changed scenario with same requestId => IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. DELAY_TIMEOUT records result at expiresAt + 1 second using DB scheduler, never sleeps holding locks.

get.description: Contract v0; implementation follows TASKS. CUSTOMER owner or ADMIN; other owners get 404. Return [] unless booking is CONFIRMED; no tickets for EXPIRED/REFUND_REQUIRED.

post.description: Contract v0; implementation follows TASKS.  Max 200 seats TOTAL across all ticket types; unique labels within event. saleStartAt < saleEndAt <= startsAt. Validate these cross-field constraints in domain.

patch.description: Contract v0; implementation follows TASKS.  ticketTypes patches existing IDs only; no mode changes, additions or deletions in v0. Reject capacity below held+sold with CATALOG_CONFLICT.
